display_long_description:
**The Official VR Golf game of the PGA TOUR!**        
*Requires Quest 3/3S and GOLF+ PASS.
                                                                                                                                                       [media]

**The green comes to you!**

The world’s greatest greens, laid across your living room floor. Every contour. Every tier. Every break. Bring your putter and a real golf ball. No controllers, just your hands and your stroke. Every putt is captured and measured, so practice stops feeling like practice and starts making you better.

REAL PUTTER. REAL BALL. THE GREEN, EXACTLY AS IT WAS DRAWN.
[media]

# GOLF+ Putting Includes:
**⛳️ Bucket List Courses**: 50+ iconic greens, from Pebble Beach to St Andrews to TPC Sawgrass. Mapped to the centimeter, so every putt breaks exactly as it would there.

**🏆 Competitive Play**: Climb the ranks and compete globally on the GOLF+ Putting Tour.

**📈 Performance Feedback**: Putt data as precise as the launch monitors the pros use. Strokes gained by distance, make and miss breakdowns, and advanced stats that show you exactly what to fix.
